extraction.Name: Louise Beauvais Young
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes, I protested to the postmaster, Mr. Weston, but he said it had been sent to me and I had to take it.
extraction.NOTES: Records show land was also sold to both J. O. Snyder and Anna Hughes, but allottee states she knows nothing about that and only dealt with Clement Valandra and Ella McHenry. Was to receive $1800 but actually received only $500 cash; remaining consideration was a barn, some horses, and a note for clothing and other articles in Winner; horses were mortgaged so she did not receive them; same applies to the barn; note holder never came to see her as promised. Has thirteen living children, nine at home. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Gross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on April 1, 1929. Did not make application for patent. Document number 9 appears at top.
